concept: A live security wire report, not a product pitch: the viewer reads a dispatch announcing a new capability, watches the kill-chain diagram prove exactly what's real (one lit node, not eight), gets the real commands, hears the maturity split stated plainly, then the frame goes alarm-red on the phrase that's earned everything shown so far.
money_shot_note: scene 5 (flash): the full frame cuts to the accent-red field on 'zero-day hunter' -- it only lands because scenes 2-4 already proved the claim instead of asserting it.
transition_strategy: hard cut is the default for this run's cuts; glitch (the reserved accent) is spent exactly once, on the cut INTO the flash money shot, so it earns its beat instead of tiling every transition.
music_direction: electronic bed, driving pulse building through the terminal and mono_block scenes; riser_braam foley climbs into the glitch-cut and peaks at the flash impact; settles for the sparkline and close.

scenes.intent: cold-open the dispatch: announce a live capability report landing, plant the project name as the poster frame
scenes.copy_note: headline reads T3MP3ST; ticker sets the wire-report frame; lede states the pitch in one line
scenes.sound_cue: wire ticker types on with a soft type-clack

scenes.intent: prove the kill chain is real by showing exactly which operator is lit and which aren't, before any hype language
scenes.copy_note: eyebrow names the kill chain; node labels are the operators, only recon accented
scenes.sound_cue: orbit drift under a low synth pad

scenes.intent: ground the pitch in the exact commands a viewer could run tonight
scenes.copy_note: pane title is the quickstart; lines are the exact npm commands from repo-study, nothing invented
scenes.sound_cue: typewriter clicks on each command line

scenes.intent: state the maturity split as text on screen so the honesty is explicit, not implied
scenes.copy_note: lines state the split plainly: recon stable, the rest experimental
scenes.sound_cue: a held tone, no swipe -- let the honesty land quiet

scenes.intent: land the money shot: the full frame goes alarm red on the phrase that earns everything shown so far
scenes.copy_note: word is the earned phrase; caption is the one-line proof
scenes.sound_cue: riser_braam foley peaks here, glitch transition in

scenes.intent: resolve the momentum thread: the count is real and still climbing, days in
scenes.copy_note: value_label is the verified star count; caption notes it's still climbing
scenes.sound_cue: an ascending pluck line under the dolly

scenes.intent: close on the wordmark so the autoloop rhymes with the open without repeating its template
scenes.copy_note: wordmark plus a tagline that closes the honesty thesis
scenes.sound_cue: sheen pass on the wordmark, tail out
